image_location_description: Bottom of the image: both feet and lower legs/boots.

steps.title: Place both soles
steps.description: Set 2x white 2x3 plates 1 stud apart; toes forward, slight splay.

steps.title: Lock the stance
steps.description: Bridge inner heels with 1x white 1x4 plate to keep legs apart.

steps.title: Build left foot block
steps.description: On left sole add 2x white 1x2 bricks (heel/mid) + 2x white 1x1 bricks (toe).

steps.title: Build right foot block
steps.description: Repeat Step 3 on the right sole for the second foot.

steps.title: Stack shin cores
steps.description: On each heel stack 2x white 1x2 bricks (2 per leg) for shin height.

steps.title: Add top mounting pads
steps.description: Cap each shin with 1x white 2x2 plate; align studs square for torso.

steps.title: Tan boot line
steps.description: Add 1x tan 1x2 plate in front of each shin on the foot top.

steps.title: DBG crease accents
steps.description: Add 1x DBG 1x2 plate on the outer side of each foot top.

steps.title: Center heel detail
steps.description: Add 1x DBG 1x1 plate on the rear center of the bridging plate.
